_agi_canonical.title: Two-State Defensive Market Making
_agi_canonical.bar: Autonomous market-making policy across benign quoting and shock/inventory-circuit-breaker states.
_agi_canonical.derivation: Required half spread is 24+5=29 bps, which remains competitive. Update is 2*45=90ms. PnL is 180,000*29/10,000-92=430. Both toxic bursts and inventory-cap breaches invoke the explicit cancel state.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All public policy outputs must match; prose is not token-graded.
